notes.title: Open World Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26226188/1c53cbc9477a77127a266b200b9aa19fbd6874f3.jpg[/img]

[h1] Open World Update [/h1]
 
   We are happy to include in this new update the ability to play freely across the entire house. This is the first step in bringing a more sandbox style gameplay, more features and objectives soon to follow.
   
[b] This new update brings you: [/b]

 [*] Sandbox mode
 [*] True open world with no loading screens 
 [*] Vast variety of enemies
 [*] Greater rewards

* This Update is available only on Windows

tags.feature: True open world with no loading screens

notes.title: First content update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26226188/3d6e95c91bbbe73971d4542c5756171be7eb7321.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce that the first content update for Squareface is out now!

Some of the new features are: 
[*] Full Xbox controller support 
[*] Ragdoll physics for enemies 
[*] New enemy type: Guardian 
[*] New costumes 
[*] New costumes made by Merca84 
[*] New weapons 
[*] New vehicle 
[*] New pets

Hope you guys will enjoy this, more future updates are coming.

notes.title: Squareface patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26226188/d5d250c3a5f74bdc024866e479abe575b560a9e1.jpg[/img]

Thanks again for all your awesome feedback and videos.

In this version we have completely changed the fixed camera mode.

Full list of changes:

[*] New third-person camera mode
[*] New Camera Settings menu
[*] Added crosshair size slider
[*] Improved Depth Of Field effect (now it's based on distance) 
[*] Reworked Bedroom Survival mission
[*] Modified explosives damage 
[*] Modified Stamina consumption and regeneration
[*] Modified secondary weapons damage
[*] Modified sniper rifle aiming
[*] Fixed some bathroom levels and lowered the difficulty 
[*] Fixed music (there was a bug that was suddenly silencing the music)
[*] Fixed "Blueprint" download button

notes.title: Squareface Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you all for the feedback and Youtube videos.

This patch contains numerous fixes for missions, shooting and AI.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26226188/36d712e685f3808791acc65d0aa58d78c62169f9.jpg[/img]

Full change list:

[*] Added new camera functionality (Camera follow - under Settings)
[*] Added prices in the build structures menu
[*] Added ranged attack to the tank pet
[*] Added improvement to the enemy AI
[*] Improved hit detection when shooting from under overlapping environment objects
[*]  Improved hit detection when shooting enemy structures
[*] Improved visibility for enemy structures heath indicators (thermometers) 
[*] Improved some missions experience ("Salvage", "Race", "Paper cut" and more)
[*] Modified the range of grenades (2X increase) 
[*] Modified the range of Teleportation skill (2X increase)
[*] Fixed some objects textures
[*] Fixed "Salvage" mission's treasure, now it can be looted. 
[*] Fixed Chainsaw animations
[*] Fixed Chainsaw damage on enemy structures
[*] Fixed "Credits" level rare elevator bug
[*] Fixed "Bedroom Survival" level enemies spawning 
[*] Fixed "Battle of Paperpylae" level 
[*] Fixed "Brutal Pool" leve and can now be finished

notes.title: Squareface Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26226188/744c4cfdc30e8190101632b32f0e3c21a72e1128.jpg[/img]

This small update contains:
- fixed Brutal Pool mission
- more tutorial tips and messages
- improvements to some early missions

We will add more content in future updates, for free.

This will include:

- New features (raggdols, jet-packs and more)

- New character customization items

- New pets and vehicles

- New weapons.

- New game modes 

We encourage everyone to give us feedback and suggestions.

Have fun!
